feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 1 June 2026 4:11am
items.description:
##Today##

Wet with occasional outbreaks of rain or drizzle for much of the day and extensive fog over modest high ground, as well as a risk of mist and fog affecting southern and eastern coastal areas at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-15


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S-SW 15-20, increasing 25 in the south at times, decreasing 5-15 later this evening, becoming variable in places later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor and falling very poor in coastal fog patches. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds in the south until later.


##Tomorrow##

Largely cloudy start with showery outbreaks of rain, then becoming drier and brighter in the afternoon/evening but with an ongoing risk of a few showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 5-15, increasing 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog soon becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Wednesday, 3 June 2026##

Occasional outbreaks of rain or drizzle arriving through the morning, this tending to clear in the afternoon but with showers following thereafter.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-12


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 15-20, soon backing S or SW 20-25, increasing 32 for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/showers. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Thursday, 4 June 2026##

Occasional blustery showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW, veering W or SW later, 20-25.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Friday, 5 June 2026##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry to start, then an increased risk of showers as the day progresses. Rain overnight into Saturday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-7


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, soon backing SW 15-20.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.
